description: Read native current Entity MIS numbers, states, units, periods and source references without recomputation, for any requested reporting period including earlier periods. Available sealed output does not require approval; disclose its actual approval status. Currently serves ordinary Entity financial statement populations returned by the catalogue, cumulative_variance_tracking year-to-date profit after tax and the reviewed services_lockup detail populations contract_lockup_v5 and customer_lockup_v5 plus visual population services_lockup and the additional reviewed native V5 detail and visual populations in the current catalogue. Also reads the four reviewed legacy business detail populations inventory_aging/v4_aging_bucket, cohort_retention/v3_cohort_cell, churn_reasons/v3_churn_reason and at_risk_customers/v5_at_risk_raw_summary. These facts retain period:null/not_declared; dates and months are context only. Cohort ratios remain fractions, native and presentation money retain their distinct currencies, and fx_rate_per_1e4 is an unchanged scaled integer, never a second conversion. Repeated aging population operands are non-additive across buckets. At-risk rules and evidence are saved source results, never rescore them. Preserve unavailable or incomplete qualification and withheld names/source text; only positively qualified fixed labels pass. Shared statement candidates in the current catalogue additionally preserve native operational and employee_pay_deferred figures, Schools saved wrappers and statutory per-row currencies. Availability and body/context qualification remain conditional; no whole-MIS promise. Statutory facts identify authenticated saved-row occurrences, not V2 identities or distinct economic totals; never deduplicate or aggregate equal-looking rows. Excluded rows without typed amounts/counts retain state and a context gap, never values parsed from prose. Native comparison columns inside the current report are current output. Use native periods when supplied, otherwise null/not_declared and saved date context; unknown meaning/custom UOM stays qualified, never replace it with a template. The average_inventory_paise descriptor in context.native_context is distinct source_context: exact fractional presentation_currency_minor lexeme, precision 0..6, authenticated currency, non_additive:true and source_ref. Keep saved null and context gaps without erasing primary turnover facts; never round or recompute that context. Use scalar with key headlines or period_highlights for their already-computed native claims and five Headlines summary counts; never substitute statement after a scalar refusal. Preserve typed null operands, native units and period:null/not_declared. Scalar concentration is a replacement proportion, ARR is annual recurring money and effort is decimal hours, never a substituted percent, monthly flow or V5 scaled-hours amount. Counts are not paging totals; saved rank/attention/in_summary are presentation context, never rerank. Do not expose Highlights position, confidence/grade/assessment/policy/template fields, private signal/suppression/binding identities or sentences. Prose-only numbers remain unqualified, never parse or rebuild them. Native zero, limitation, qualified empty, absent and unverified states are distinct; absent is not numerical zero or complete coverage. Select the catalogue population_kind and population_key together; other report families remain unfinished coverage. Use the run_id returned by current-run discovery; returned version is a source citation, not an input selector. Superseded versions are not accessible. Preserve the actual physical run_id/version/report_id/population_kind/population_key across every signed continuation; fetch every page before claiming a complete answer. delivery.state === "complete" means only the named server traversal, never all MIS or confirmed client receipt. total_rows:null means the public item total is unknown; native coverage counters are not paging totals. Use delivered native table and chart values; never reconstruct totals or combine recognized and estimated values into an unlabeled claim. Preserve each supplied detail period or native null/not_declared gap and the declared visual interval; do not infer periods from scope or basis metadata. Scaled physical facts keep their integer amounts, precision 0 and owning hours_1e4, quantity_1e4, minutes_1e4 or minutes_1e8 unit; arbitrary source UOM text does not replace that unit. Source currency context does not replace the presentation currency attached to money. Detail ratios use fraction while visual ratios use ratio: native effort 0.2 and visual Machine OEE 0.75 are not the display amounts 20 or 75. Coverage counters and native availability remain independent of value defined state and delivery completion. Supplier visuals cover the authenticated top twelve by signed net purchases; that completion does not exhaust full supplier detail or authorize a new ranking or total. Withheld reason text, UOM and methodology-version text have explicit qualification flags and are not missing financial values. Ordinary statement values may retain semantic_meaning_not_qualified and display_label_state:withheld: keep the value and safe citation, disclose incomplete meaning, and never substitute a template label, raw line code or current Entity label. Preserve the period and tax context of each column; flow, position, current, prior, budget and rolling intervals are not interchangeable. Absent or indeterminate tax is not zero tax. The native FCF before P&L finance charge figure is indicative, not conventional tax-shielded unlevered FCF. sourceCurrentnessStatus concerns the Entity trial-balance source only, not whole-MIS freshness; not_recorded and not_applicable are not verified_current, and isStale:false alone does not attest freshness. If source_changed is returned because the current run was replaced, discard the partial assembly, rediscover the current run and restart at page 1; never stitch versions. A late integrity or unsupported error makes assembly incomplete: stop, disclose incomplete delivery, and never reconstruct subtotals, fill missing numbers, or fall back to latest. Respect LineageValue precision and unit: money 10001 INR precision 2 is 100.01; fractions and percentages differ. Use native unavailable states unchanged. Additional ratios require defined supplied operands with compatible periods, units/currency and populations, citations and an analyst-interpretation label; never replace a Datavrn metric. A zero or non-positive denominator is not meaningful (null, defined:false), never zero; denominator reasons take precedence. A negative magnitude numerator is not meaningful (negative_numerator); signed earnings, margins, growth, working capital and free cash flow retain their sign. A true zero magnitude numerator is defined zero unless the metric-specific rule requires not meaningful at zero. Retained amounts with defined:false are unavailable analytical operands. No raw inputs, identity bridges or internal notes are exposed.

page_token.description: Signed immutable-source continuation from the previous page.

population_key.description: Exact named population key from the catalogue; defaults to report_id for statement reads.

population_kind.description: Named population kind from the catalogue; defaults to statement.

report_id.description: Exact report identifier returned by the catalogue.

run_id.description: Current Entity run UUID returned by list_entity_mis_runs.
